title: helianthemum nummularium subsp. berteroanum
intro: Helianthemum nummularium subsp. berteroanum, commonly known as Corsican rockrose, is a plant species within the family Cistaceae. It is a flowering plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The health benefits of Helianthemum nummularium subsp. berteroanum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which may help to alleviate conditions such as wounds, digestive issues, and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions.
